title: Customer 360 & Hyper-Personalization
seo_title: Customer 360 & Hyper-Personalization | Solution | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Customer 360 & Hyper-Personalization — composed architecture, platform stack and the metric the program answers to.

blocks.x: A working definition of Customer 360 & Hyper-Personalization for the enterprise: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.
The problem this solution exists for
Customer truth is scattered across product silos, channels and vendors; personalization runs on segments built quarters ago, and privacy governance arrives as an afterthought that blocks launches.
Our approach

We build the identity spine first (consent-scoped, clean-room-ready), unify behavioral, transactional and service data with certified definitions, then wire decision APIs for next-best-action into every channel with measurement that proves incrementality.

Components

items: Durable IDs, consent scopes and preference management
Streaming unification with certified customer definitions
Next-best-action, offers and timing served in the moment
Profiling governance designed before the first campaign

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on EEMS Platform and Fleet Management System: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with a full evidence trail for each decision. The governed data estate every AI program needs.
How it runs in an engagement

items: We measure the starting position and lock the baseline with your team — no build work begins before the number is agreed.
A bounded pilot on your real data, with the gate review scheduled before the first commit is written.
Runbooks, enablement and the control trail that let your teams operate it without us in the room.
Quarterly re-audits and a ranked backlog of the next decisions worth automating — value that accumulates on purpose.

blocks.x: Engineering standards & stack

items: A single governance plane over tables, models and notebooks — access your auditors can replay.
Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.
Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

The readiness work for Customer 360 & Hyper-Personalization is unglamorous and decisive — data contracts, access paths and owner names. Programs that skip it discover the gaps at the first gate, which is the most expensive place to find them.
How a delivery runs

Customer 360 & Hyper-Personalization follows the same delivery pattern as every Achala program — baseline, bounded pilot, gate review, then scale. The difference from a traditional program is that each step produces evidence your auditors can walk.
Outcomes we commit to

items: conversion lift carries the program: if the delta stalls, the gate redirects scope toward it before anything else
We commit to contact cost as a measured outcome — reported every fortnight, audited at the gate, owned by a name on both sides.
consent compliance defines success for this pattern and is audited against the week-two baseline at every gate
